name: nolossmeme
description: Memecoins you cannot lose on. NEAR HACKATHON 2026 monorepo.

scripts.contracts:build: cd contracts && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --locked
scripts.contracts:lint: cd contracts && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @nolossmeme/sdk build && cd contracts && cargo test --workspace --lib && cd .. && pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.test:regression: pnpm --filter @nolossmeme/sdk build && cd contracts && cargo test --workspace regression && cd .. && pnpm --filter @nolossmeme/sdk --filter @nolossmeme/web --filter @nolossmeme/keeper exec vitest run -t regression
